_about: Copy to config.local.json and fill in what you use. Every key is optional; leave one out to turn that feature off. config.local.json is ignored by git.
_public_base: Address of the server that runs src/service.py; deploy.sh checks the pages there and search jobs report progress to it.
_box: ssh target for deploy.sh and for credits.py requests/done. Leave out to run everything on one machine.
_box_project: Folder on the server (relative to the ssh login's home) that holds src/ and site/.
_email_archive_cmd: Optional command that answers one read-only query about your email (JSON on stdin: {op: sql, db, table, sql}; prints {rows: [...]}); credits.py flags uses it to spot booking emails. Leave out to turn the email check off.
_notes_inbox: Folder where credits.py record drops a dated Markdown snapshot of balances and credits. Leave out to skip snapshots.
_old_links: Links shown at the bottom of the home page.
_skill_dir: Folder with the written search steps (SKILL.md and scripts) that a search job follows.
_ask_router: Optional command that picks which Claude login and model answer questions; prints JSON {status: ROUTED, provider: claude, seat_dir, model, effort, account}. Leave empty to use the default claude login and ask_model.
_mac: ssh target of the Mac that runs search jobs with a signed-in browser. Leave out to turn search jobs off.
_mac_profile: Optional name of a Claude config folder (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR) under mac_profiles_dir for jobs; empty uses the default login.
_rules_tool: Optional command that can refuse a login for jobs and name the model (subcommands: json, default-model); empty skips it.
_policy_file: Optional extra file a search job may read.
_browser_mcp: Name of the MCP server that drives the signed-in browser for search jobs.
_rules_file: Optional JSON file listing logins, used with rules_tool.
